name: bb-plugin-codex-theme
description: A bb palette that brings the OpenAI Codex / ChatGPT desktop app's look: typography, surfaces, composer geometry, and rail sizing.

bb.name: Codex Theme
bb.description: The OpenAI Codex / ChatGPT desktop look: system-font typography at 430 weight, Codex surfaces and menus, a 26px composer with the Codex send arrow, and a roomier left rail. Pick Catppuccin or BB colors, and turn on optional changes in the plugin settings.

themes.name: Codex
themes.description: Visual and layout parity with the OpenAI Codex / ChatGPT desktop app on the Catppuccin palette: SF Pro at 430 weight on a 14px scale, Codex surface and menu geometry, the Codex send arrow, and a scaled-up navigation rail. Light and dark.

themes.name: Codex (BB colors)
themes.description: The same Codex layout and typography on BB's default light and dark colors, with Pierre syntax highlighting.
